source_and_option_review: All14 cases audited before inference and rechecked after outputs; exact rational numerical equalities verified. Codex authored review, not independent external certification.

consolidation_notes.person_categories: On-duty contractor versus off-duty passenger roles; distinct from accident severity. Correctness differs by option order even with evidence.
consolidation_notes.invoice_financing_basis: Invoice collateral and financial-health basis; distinct from valuation and outsourcing responsibility. Both closed errors omit supplier-invoice collateral; both source orders correct.
consolidation_notes.facility_and_flow_joint_design: Joint opening and allocation costs with capacity; distinct from component BOM netting. Exact four feasible configuration bounds establish minimum65; includes arithmetic/optimization rather than pure recall.
consolidation_notes.carrying_cost_boundary: Annual holding-expense boundary and duplicate operating cost; distinct from IAS2 inventory balance-sheet valuation. One-order error omits the derived12% rate.
consolidation_notes.outsourcing_stage_dependencies: Order of stages and separation of offer evaluation from service monitoring; distinct from retained management responsibility, which was not an old gap family.
consolidation_notes.hs_domestic_extensions: International six-digit prefix versus Japan domestic suffix; neither source existed in the previous candidate registry. One-order error conflates different six-digit prefixes.

limitations: Archived frameworks and explicitly provided scenario assumptions, not current legal or financial advice. Two permutations are not independent seeds. Evidence scores are not training gains. Three one-order failures are position sensitive; do not infer stable deficits.
